observations: Hugh and Brie now stand out practically, though neither dominates enough to call obvious.
Repeated admissions of entering an empty room feel constructed to distribute access, while concrete personal reasons help.
Original contents versus inert wording is pivotal but dispersed among several statements; uncertainty about who knew actual toxicity persists.
